sloka: तं तैलधौतं विमलं शैलसारमयं दृढम्।राक्षसः परमक्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रे न्यपातयत् ।। ६.९९.१८ ।।
transliteration: taṁ tailadhautaṁ vimalaṁ śailasāramayaṁ dṛḍham।rākṣasaḥ paramakruddho vāliputre nyapātayat ।। 6.99.18 ।।

translations.english: Extremely enraged Rakshasa, hurled at Vali's son that axe that was cleansed with oil, the clean strong axe that was like feet of a mountain.
